---
title: "0805 — Update Entity Classification Index"
output: html_notebook
---

Run this after `0804_classify_contributors.py` completes. Appends newly classified
entities to `entity_classification_index.csv`, which is the persistent source of
truth for all classifications (prior seed, waterfall output, and manual review).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
```

```{r}
classified_out <- read_csv("08_outputs/classified_contributors.csv",
                            col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
  transmute(
    classification_unit_id,
    entity_id,
    entity_type,
    canonical_name,
    employer,
    occupation,
    naics_code,
    naics_label,
    level1_category,
    level2_category,
    classification_source  = coalesce(data_source_1, "unclassified"),
    classification_status  = if_else(!is.na(level1_category), "classified", "unclassified")
  )

entity_index <- if (file.exists("08_outputs/entity_classification_index.csv")) {
  read_csv("08_outputs/entity_classification_index.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
} else {
  tibble(classification_unit_id = character())
}

n_before <- nrow(entity_index)

entity_index_updated <- bind_rows(entity_index, classified_out) %>%
  distinct(classification_unit_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

n_added <- nrow(entity_index_updated) - n_before

write_csv(entity_index_updated, "08_outputs/entity_classification_index.csv")
message("Index updated: ", n_added, " new rows added (", nrow(entity_index_updated), " total).")
```

```{r}
entity_index_updated %>%
  count(classification_source, classification_status, sort = TRUE)
```
